description: Source code for the ProcessHost class managing child processes, IPC communication, and process lifecycle in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: ProcessHost
classes.description: Manages a child process, IPC messaging, and process lifecycle events.

methods.name: startRunner
methods.description: Starts the child process with specified runner parameters and options.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the child process and returns a promise for the response.

methods.name: sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message without expecting a reply.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Hook for handling process exit; currently empty.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Registers a request handler for specific IPC methods.

methods.name: didSendStop
methods.description: Checks if a stop command has been sent.

methods.name: producedEnv
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by the process.
